import json

  'action': 'continue',
  'reason': 'Continue attribution and repeat confirmation of relation-content/count-shrink compatibility. Validation macro AUC improves 0.000525 over entry and 0.018173 over DIN. Equal-parameter count-versus-fixed contrasts improve 0.000175–0.000193 across absolute/centered variants; centering adds only 0.000017–0.000035. These single-seed contrasts provisionally favor count dependence, not a centering mechanism or confirmed complementarity. Retain both frozen source bests as replacement controls, distinguish inherited utility from added capacity, and measure training/inference cost. Current best uses 32,964,809 parameters and 31.88s inference versus entry-source count shrink at 32,288,965 parameters and 24.29s; it trails newer feedback factorization by 0.001903 AUC while using 31.88s versus 36.95s inference. Repeatable gains over source and capacity controls would support continuation; disappearance under those controls would oppose it. All tasks improve AUC/logloss over DIN; favorite AUC slightly regresses versus entry despite improved logloss, and buy regresses versus count shrink. These trade-offs limit the utility claim.',
  'evidence_refs': [
    'baseline-din',
    'g0-r0003-relation_content_counts',
    'g2-r0004-count_shrink',
    'g2-r0011-center_count',
    'g2-r0011-center_fixed',
    'g2-r0011-absolute_count',
    'g2-r0011-absolute_fixed',
    'g0-r0010-feedback_factorized'
  ],
  'task_tradeoffs': {
    'is_click': 'Current best versus DIN: AUC +0.015124, logloss -0.001877; versus topic entry: AUC +0.000584, logloss -0.000101. Both improve, but single-seed evidence remains provisional.',
    'cart': 'Versus DIN: AUC +0.018675, logloss -0.002284; versus entry: AUC +0.000676, logloss -0.000094. Count-versus-fixed in the centered contrast lowers AUC by 0.000362 and worsens logloss by 0.000033; macro benefit is not uniform.',
    'fav': 'Versus DIN: AUC +0.014000, logloss -0.001548; versus entry: AUC -0.000033, logloss -0.000044. Slight ranking regression accompanies improved logloss; no undeclared task veto is applied.',
    'buy': 'Versus DIN: AUC +0.024891, logloss -0.001554; versus entry: AUC +0.000874, logloss -0.000073. Centered count-versus-fixed AUC improves 0.001064, but versus standalone count shrink AUC falls 0.002008 and logloss rises 0.000246; compatibility remains unresolved.'
  }
}
p = Path('/workspace/topic-decision.json')
